The money matches the line: FY2021 research, development, test and evaluation, Army funds against 0605625A, an RDT&E program element whose own J-book narrative owns the name 'Optionally Manned Fighting Vehicle (OMFV)'. refute_b.reason: 'Optionally Manned Fighting Vehicle (OMFV)' is a single row in the A index (0605625A, doc 355); no other PE owns the name, the only nearby name is 'The Bradley Fighting Vehicle (BFV)' on a different vehicle, and the evidence is the program name itself rather than a contractor or a variant designator.

proposals.announcement_evidence: was awarded a $26,489,184 firm-fixed-price contract for the High-Performance Computing Modernization Program
proposals.rationale: The announcement names the program as the object of the award, and the index row is the same program under its abbreviated budget-line spelling, so the alias is the budget document's own contraction rather than an invented one. The money test decides which of the two HPCMP lines this is: the award cites fiscal 2024 other procurement, Army funds, which belongs to the procurement line 3005B66501 and not to the RDT&E PE 0603461A that carries the fully spelled name (proposed separately as weak). The contracting activity is the Corps of Engineers' Engineer Research and Development Center, the Army's executive agent for HPCMP hardware buys, and the deliverable is the computing capability itself, not engineering support around it.

refute_a.reason: FY2024 other procurement, Army funds land on the B-prefix Other Procurement, Army line item of the same name — appropriation and line type agree exactly — and the FFP buy is HPCMP's own supercomputing hardware at the Aberdeen DSRC, contracted by the program's executive agent, not services around a platform.

refute_b.reason: Name collision with a better-matching owner: the announcement's verbatim string 'High-Performance Computing Modernization Program' is an EXACT index row on a different PE (0603461A, doc 351), while this proposal reaches 3005B66501 only by alias — the name evidence links elsewhere at least as well, and only the appropriation (lens A's test, not lens B's) separates the twins.

proposals.announcement_evidence: was awarded a $26,489,184 firm-fixed-price contract for the High-Performance Computing Modernization Program
